content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Article X(b) (¶p0125) imposes a one-sided non-solicit on us (Licensee only), covering *all* persons employed by Licensor and its Affiliates, for the Term plus three years after expiration or termination — beyond the 24-month/all-personnel walk-away line. The clause's existing definition of "Solicit" already carves out general job advertising and voluntary/unsolicited inquiries, and it prohibits only solicitation "to leave" employment (no no-hire).

**Redline (fallback):** a single surgical replacement of the first sentence making the covenant mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the services provided under the Agreement, and capped at 12 months after that involvement ends — leaving the carve-out sentence verbatim.
